title: Rocuronium — Pediatric RSI Paralysis

changelog.change: Fixed 'sugammadec' → 'sugammadex' typo; cross-linked the new peds-succinylcholine-rsi card.

purpose: Non-depolarizing paralytic for RSI. Default when succinylcholine is contraindicated; reversible with sugammadex.

doses.notes: Onset ~45-60 s at RSI dose, duration 30-60 min. No fasciculations, no hyperkalemia risk.

reversal: Sugammadex 16 mg/kg for immediate reversal of an RSI dose.
buildNote: Succinylcholine is the faster-onset/shorter-duration depolarizing alternative — see peds-succinylcholine-rsi for its dosing and contraindications (hyperkalemia risk, myopathy, MH history).
